newsitem.title: USA: CSCE cocoa ends flat to firmer ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: CSCE cocoa ends flat to firmer ahead of holiday.

text.p: CSCE cocoa futures settled unchanged to firmer Wednesday, slipping from morning highs after a round of trade selling trimmed gains, floor sources said.
Prices jumped to six-week highs at the outset, bolstered by speculative shortcovering, traders said. But most-active March delivery bumped into resistance at $1,425 a tonne.
In the afternoon, traders said players largely concentrated on adjusting positions ahead of the four-day weekend.
CSCE will be closed Thursday and Friday in observance of U.S. Thanksgiving.
March cocoa ended unchanged at $1,416 after trading from $1,425 to $1,409. Spot December settled unchanged too, at $1,371, while the back months finished flat to $9 firmer.
Technically, traders continued to peg near-term resistance for March cocoa at $1,425, with the next level seen at $1,433. Support was put at $1,408, then $1,400.
Volume was moderate at an estimated at 7,038 lots.
